summary: Engine-independent map marker button for a vehicle, asset, person, or travel group with operating-state color, bearing, an optional dashed outline, and a hover or focus caption.
useWhen: An application map needs a consistent interactive marker for one entity.
The map engine can mount a custom element and retain ownership of coordinates, anchoring, and camera behavior.
avoidWhen: Several nearby entities must be represented as one count; use MapClusterMarker.
An application-defined point, location, or event needs a semantic intent and arbitrary map icon; use MapMarker.
The content is a legend item or non-interactive status swatch.
The component would be asked to own geographic coordinates, clustering, map-engine adapters, or selected-entity business state.

alternatives.when: An application-defined map point needs semantic intent color and an arbitrary map icon.
alternatives.reason: MapMarker owns generic intent-based point and event semantics without entity motion behavior.

alternatives.when: Several nearby entities are represented by a compact count.
alternatives.reason: MapClusterMarker owns cluster count formatting and cluster interaction geometry.

accessibility: The component renders a native button and label is its accessible action name. Prefer an action-oriented label such as ‘Open vehicle 412’.
Caption is a supplemental visual identifier and is hidden from assistive technology to avoid duplicating label.
Keyboard focus reveals the same caption as hover and uses the shared visible focus ring.
Operating-state and outline meaning must be present in nearby map legend or application detail content; do not rely on marker color alone.
The optional dashed outline remains differentiated by a dashed border in forced-colors mode.
states: Unknown represents unavailable current motion and uses the existing stale-background token. The application resolves stale telemetry to Unknown regardless of previous motion; a known Immobilized state takes precedence.
The dashed outline is an independent visual option. Unknown is solid unless the owner explicitly requests dashes.

immobilized is a vehicle-only state. A MapEntityVehicle marker in that state renders the upright MapKey glyph so immobilization is identifiable without interpreting bearing; other entity icons are preserved.

bearing rotates only MapEntityTravelGroup and MapEntityVehicle glyphs and is normalized to a clockwise value from 0 through 359 degrees. The immobilized vehicle replacement, asset, person, and other glyphs remain upright.

dimmed is visual de-emphasis only. The map owner decides when selection context should dim peer markers and keeps every marker operable. A dimmed marker returns to full opacity while hovered or keyboard-focused so its revealed caption remains legible.
Activation emits dsClick without changing application selection internally.
responsiveBehavior: Marker geometry stays fixed across breakpoints so map-engine anchors remain stable.
The map owner controls collision handling, overlays, and viewport-aware caption placement.

customElements: A map engine that accepts an Element for a custom marker or div icon can mount ds-map-entity-marker directly.
Listen for dsClick and keep selected entity, z-index, coordinates, and camera movement in application state.
react: Pass numeric bearing as a property and handle dsClick through the generated event binding.
angular: Bind bearing as a number and keep map-engine marker lifecycle in the owning map adapter.

styling.rationale: The component owns stable map anchoring geometry and semantic marker recipes; the map engine owns host placement and stacking.

protected.reason: Marker geometry, operating-state colors, outline distinction, and de-emphasis are one accessible visual recipe.
